author: SeverinDiederichs
body:
This PR fixes the configuration of Russian Roulette (RR) in the Phase2 setup.

Previously, even if the HGCal (per default turned off) or the ZDC (per default turned on) were configured to use RR, the `gRRactive` flag would remain turned off, i.e., it was not possible to turn on RR in them if it was not activated by some other region.

This PR enables that if the RR probability is set to a finite value in HGCal or ZDC, it is also activated (which mirrors the behavior of the other regions).

This does not change the default settings of the probability and keeps the HGCAL per default turned off and the ZDC per default turned on.

@civanch @kpedro88
title: set RR active also for HGCal and ZDC
